caseName: Toledo Pressed Steel Co. v. Standard Parts, Inc.
caseNameFull: Toledo Pressed Steel Co. v. Standard Parts, Inc. and Same v. Huebner Supply Co.
attorneys: Mr. Wilber Owen for petitioner., Messrs. William P. Bair and Will Freeman for respondents.

opinions.text:
The petition for rehearing is granted. The orders denying certiorari, ante, p. 600, are vacated and the petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is granted.

Reported below: 93 F. 2d 336.
